name: Orator
overview: Scripture presents the orator as a figure skilled in speech and communication, exemplified by individuals like Apollos, described as eloquent and knowledgeable in the Scriptures, and Tertullus, who acted as a formal spokesman in a legal setting. The role of the orator includes proclaiming God’s message boldly, as seen in Jonah’s public declaration of Nineveh’s impending judgment. Isaiah highlights the orator’s esteemed position alongside leaders and counselors, emphasizing the importance of effective speech in guiding and influencing others within God’s purposes.
